legacy_default.reason: Superstage S1 resolves a root with no Planning mode field as legacy incremental regardless of SUPER_PLANNING_MODE, without rewriting it.

invalid_trailing_planning_mode.reason: Supergoal step 1 requires an invalid trailing --planning-mode value to return the specified error before scratch or vault writes; S1 classifies an invalid mode as BLOCKED.

incremental_mode_persisted.reason: Supergoal step 4 requires a new incremental root to carry **Planning mode:** incremental; Superstage S1 resolves that exact marker as incremental.

bounded_unknown.reason: Superstage S2 permits bounded predecessor-dependent filenames when evidence, bounds, resolution method, and invalidation triggers are stated, but S3 makes a Preparation: none stage needs-refinement and non-executable.

missing_architecture.reason: Superstage S2 requires a chosen architecture and says an upfront stage may not defer it; unbounded foundational uncertainty invalidates the graph.

open_provider.reason: Superstage S3 says an open or unmerged provider PR is unsatisfied, so it cannot satisfy a consumer dependency; C9 cannot mark the active goal complete without verified integrated delivery.

declined_provider.reason: Superstage S3 and supertraverse C9 say a provider decline closes only that provider obligation; the live consumer remains non-executable and the goal cannot complete until an adopted replan removes or replaces the dependency.

dependency_cycle.reason: Superstage S2 treats cycles in active stage dependencies as a concrete graph fault and returns BLOCKED.

temporary_upfront_gate.reason: Supertraverse C6 states that in the current build every upfront selection returns BLOCKED under the Task 1 transition gate until Tasks 3 and 5 install consumers.

unlinked_active_row.reason: Superstage S2 requires complete active-scope coverage and no blank active Plan cells, and expressly forbids repairing a published graph through incremental gap filling.

multi_level_complete_tree.reason: Superstage S1/S2 permit candidate validation through a complete intended-vault-to-scratch path map and the stated graph satisfies S2; S3 still classifies Preparation: none leaves as needs-refinement rather than executable.

draft_interrupted_before_confirmation.reason: Supergoal's scratch interface records the complete scratch set and remaining gate, while its override of A5 forbids vault publication before confirmation; authoring never executes code under A1.

resume_identical_source.reason: Supergoal's resume contract says a matching draft reuses its folder, paths, and stable IDs without allocating another folder or stage ID, then reapplies the current confirmation gate.

resume_changed_source.reason: Supergoal requires a changed source digest to have an explicitly revised scratch draft; until then it preserves the old draft and reports DRAFT-INCOMPLETE with Draft action revise.

confirmation_refused.reason: Supergoal's confirmation override permits vault writes only after human approval or the two-factor auto-confirm condition; refusal leaves the reviewed artifact in scratch and authoring does not execute code.

supermeta_draft_incomplete.reason: Supermeta step 6 says a PLANNER result containing DRAFT-INCOMPLETE and a Draft index preserves and reports that index, writes nothing to the ledger, and exits.

local_detail.reason: Superstage S4 assigns refinement to PLAN_REFINER when scope, acceptance, approach, dependency edges, and shared contract semantics remain intact; filenames, helpers, and test setup are listed refinement details.

contract_break.reason: Superstage S4 requires structural replanning by REPLANNER when verified evidence changes shared contract behavior or semantic revision, with downstream consumers assessed at the dependency boundary.
